import numpy as np

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(3)
    amp = 1 / np.sqrt(3)
    # |001> = 1, |010> = 2, |100> = 4  in little-endian ordering
    vec = np.zeros(8, dtype=complex)
    vec[1] = amp   # |001>
    vec[2] = amp   # |010>
    vec[4] = amp   # |100>
    qc.initialize(vec, [0, 1, 2])
    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
import numpy as np

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(3)

    # W state preparation for qubits 2,1,0
    # |100> + |010> + |001>
    theta1 = 2 * np.arcsin(1 / np.sqrt(3))      # sin(theta1/2)=1/sqrt3
    theta2 = np.pi / 2                          # sin(theta2/2)=1/sqrt2

    qc.ry(theta1, 2)

    # Ry on qubit 1 controlled by qubit 2 == 0
    qc.x(2)
    qc.cry(theta2, 2, 1)
    qc.x(2)

    # X on qubit 0 controlled by qubit 2 == 0 and qubit 1 == 0
    # Ry(pi) = X up to phase
    qc.x(2)
    qc.x(1)
    qc.ccx(2, 1, 0)
    qc.x(1)
    qc.x(2)

    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
import math

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(3)

    # W state  |001> + |010> + |100>  / sqrt(3)
    # first split on qubit 0
    theta1 = 2 * math.asin(1 / math.sqrt(3))   # sin(theta1/2)=1/sqrt3
    theta2 = math.pi / 2                       # sin(theta2/2)=1/sqrt2

    qc.ry(theta1, 0)

    # controlled Ry on qubit 1 with control qubit 0 == 0
    # CRY decomposed as Ry(theta/2) - CX - Ry(-theta/2) - CX
    qc.x(0)
    qc.ry(theta2 / 2, 1)
    qc.cx(0, 1)
    qc.ry(-theta2 / 2, 1)
    qc.cx(0, 1)
    qc.x(0)

    # move the remaining |000> amplitude to |100>
    # Toffoli with controls 0==0 and 1==0 on target 2
    qc.x(0)
    qc.x(1)
    qc.ccx(0, 1, 2)
    qc.x(1)
    qc.x(0)

    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.circuit.library import WState


def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(3)
    # The 3-qubit W state is 1/sqrt(3)(|001> + |010> + |100>)
    # which is exactly 1/sqrt(3)(|100> + |010> + |001>) up to ordering
    qc.compose(WState(3), inplace=True)
    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
import numpy as np


def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(3)

    # W state on qubits 0,1,2
    # sin(theta1/2)=1/sqrt(3)  -> first rotation on qubit 0
    theta1 = 2 * np.arcsin(1 / np.sqrt(3))
    # sin(theta2/2)=1/sqrt(2)  -> conditional rotation on qubit 1
    theta2 = np.pi / 2

    qc.ry(theta1, 0)

    # CRY on qubit 1 controlled by qubit 0 == 0
    qc.x(0)
    qc.cry(theta2, 0, 1)
    qc.x(0)

    # flip qubit 2 iff qubit 0 == 0 and qubit 1 == 0
    qc.x(0)
    qc.x(1)
    qc.ccx(0, 1, 2)
    qc.x(1)
    qc.x(0)

    return qc
